content:
marta: Quick heads-up — I'm opening PR #812 to merge the KMS/HSM networking playbook sections for private and VPC installs. I pulled together the air-gapped note and the nftables example; need eyes on the link targets and that kube-proxy caveat.

cheng: Thanks — will review in a bit. Quick question: did you keep the port matrix row for HSM management (TCP 6010) or move it into the appendix?

marta: Moved it to appendix but left cross-ref in the main install flow. If you'd prefer inline I'll revert.

sam: Minor nit: links to the RFC for PKCS11 are 404 in the draft. I fixed one but there's another in the HSM credentials section.

priya: Pinged infra to confirm the nat/gateway recommendation. For the nftables snippet, can we use this condensed command to avoid misleading stateful rules:

```
# allow collector -> kms
nft add rule inet redwood forward tcp dport 443 ct state established,related accept
nft add rule inet redwood forward tcp dport 443 ct state new accept
```

cheng: Looks good. Also left an inline suggestion to mention we recommend HSM FW rules be limited to mgmt subnet rather than node IPs.

docs-ci-bot: PR checks passed — linkchecker found 1 broken link (PKCS11 RFC) flagged by @sam.

sam: I can update that link to the archived RFC URL.

marta: Awesome. Plan: I'll merge after sam patches and priya confirms the nat guidance. If anything urgent speak now, otherwise merging EOD.

priya: Confirmed; infra prefers mgmt subnet recommendation. :thumbsup:

cheng: +1

sam: Patch pushed — replaced RFC link and fixed HSM heading level.

marta: Thanks all — merging now. Will also add a short "what changed" blurb to the changelog so support sees the playbook consolidation.
